policy.x_launch_flags_rationale: D-01. Without -noreset the last X client disconnecting raises DE_RESET, which runs the clean close, zeroes sessionNonce and permanently disables Gate A with no fatal and no log line (Q10). Every negative observation would be unattributable.
policy.null_means: NOT OBSERVED. Never inferred, never defaulted.
policy.frozen_attempt_policy: Frozen attempts are never reclassified or rerun. An INVALID attempt consumes its number; the next attempt takes the next number.

cells.name: cold restart with a non-terminal old registry — containment halt
construction: arm fault 8 via TERMUX_X11_GATEA_TEST_FAULT=8 and TERMUX_X11_GATEA_TEST_ARM=1
drive one direct exact composite so the pair is LEASED (X sets pendingCount=1 on both endpoints at cmdentrypoint.cpp:226-227)
fault 8 fires after CONSUME_DIRECT is traced but BEFORE the fence: gateARendererFatal PUBLISHES generationFatal and the renderer exits
X observes EOF with fatal != 0, so lorieGateAActive() is FALSE and X takes the else-branch (closeLorieConnection) instead of x-eof: X SURVIVES with sessionNonce intact
the next lorieActivityConnected() attempts the generation bump and meets a registry entry with pendingCount != 0
cells.pass_requires: the EXACT expected fatal fired AND the new generation was NOT opened
invalid: the renderer died without publishing (then X would take x-eof and not survive) -> INVALID_CONSTRUCTION
the registry was terminal at the bump -> INVALID_CONSTRUCTION, the lease did not persist
cells.fail: the bump SUCCEEDED over a non-terminal registry

cells.name: stale-ready replay — expected containment fatal
construction: arm fault 16 via TERMUX_X11_GATEA_TEST_FAULT=16 and TERMUX_X11_GATEA_TEST_ARM=1
drive a Gate A register so gateAValidateImport runs (renderer.cpp:512)
fault 16 fires at renderer.cpp:674-679: after the legitimate READY, the renderer sends a SECOND READY with (nonce-1, generation-1)
X receives it, gateAFrameTupleMatch fails, gateAFatalFromInput(FAIL_GENERATION, "x-wrong-generation")
forbid: concluding PASS from absence of harm — the EXACT expected fatal is required (§8.8)
designing this as a defence: Q5 proved a stale READY cannot be CONSUMED by a new generation; F1 proves the frame-path HALT
invalid: Gate A was INACTIVE when the stale frame arrived: handleGateARecord silently drops it before the tuple check (cmdentrypoint.cpp:629-631) -> INVALID_CONSTRUCTION, NOT a pass and NOT a fail
gateAValidateImport was never reached (no register) -> INVALID_CONSTRUCTION
cells.fail: the stale frame was ACCEPTED, or a different fatal fired

cells.name: fresh session recovery after F1's fatal
cells.precondition: R9-F1 PASS with its expected fatal. §8.8: if that fatal does not exist, F2 is BLOCKED, and manufacturing another fatal to satisfy the precondition is FORBIDDEN.
construction: start a genuinely fresh session: a new X process and a new Activity process
drive one clean direct exact composite
forbid: manufacturing another fatal to satisfy the precondition
judging residue against an unwindowed logcat capture — the obs sink survives process death and `logcat -c` is a redline (Q11-F2); logcat-since.txt must be recorded
inferring the Activity died from socket closure alone (Q11-F1); (PID, starttime) is required
cells.pass_requires: new nonce AND empty registry AND a clean direct SUCCESS with event=5 in the ring
invalid: F1's expected fatal absent -> BLOCKED, not INVALID
cells.fail: stale residue present, or no direct success

product_level_finding: GATE A HAS NO REACHABLE CLEAN SAME-PROCESS GENERATION BOUNDARY. A clean close zeroes sessionNonce and is terminal (Q10); the bump path is correctly built but reaching it needs either a warm reconnect entry point that does not exist, or an Activity death, which fatals X unless generationFatal is ALREADY set. Every generation boundary in a surviving X therefore requires a prior fatal — which is why all three surviving cells are fatal-path cells. Belongs to D-06; recorded, not decided.
